Fit check: **fits Feature flow** — single-surface change (one store field + one picker + one resolve path), no breakdown needed. Implemented.

## What changed

**Store** — pick lives on task branch in `metadata.json` `routing["<stage>"] = { tool, model }`:
- `server/bridza-run.js:1132` `stageRouting()` reads branch tip; `setStageRouting()` writes+commits (modelled on `setTaskReuse`).
- `runStage` now resolves `body.tool || routing[stage].tool` (`server/bridza-run.js:757`) and records `{tool, model}` of what actually ran (incl. fallback agent) into `routing` on the prompt commit.
- Saved model applies only when resolved tool == saved tool → stale model never carried onto another agent.

**Wiring** — `POST /api/bridza/task/routing` (`server/bridge.js:236`), `api.setStageRouting` (client.js), `routing` surfaced on tasks in `readProject` (`server/bridza-store.js:537`).

**UI** — `StageRunner` seeds `routing[def.id]` → last run → `def.tool` → `opencode`; persists at **pick** time (tool change, model blur, `×` clear), no-op guard so untouched blur doesn't materialise a worktree. `automate()` builds bodies from routing first and now passes `model` (previously never passed).

**Docs** — `docs/09-file-format.md` shows populated `routing` shape.

**Tests** — `bridza-run.test.js`: round-trip w/ zero runs, stage+task independence + overwrite, `runStage` resolving from routing when body omits tool and explicit tool winning. `ux-views.test.jsx`: picker seeds agent+model from routing ahead of run history.
